protocol.scope: Artifact completeness only; does not certify convergence or quality.

bootstrap.unit: independent test trajectory; all its windows kept together
bootstrap.estimand: equal-trajectory mean metric difference, first minus second
bootstrap.scope: conditional on each seed's fitted models and saved draws
bootstrap.excludes: training variability and resampling forecast ensembles
bootstrap.multiple_comparisons: 95% intervals are unadjusted across comparisons and metrics.

metric_definitions.crps: empirical ensemble CRPS, lower is better
metric_definitions.coverage_90: marginal coverage of empirical central 90% intervals
metric_definitions.quantiles: linear interpolation; finite scored ensemble size
metric_definitions.ensemble_monte_carlo: Densiffusion draws sharing a sampled dense history are dependent. Equal draw counts do not imply equal Monte Carlo precision or finite-ensemble CRPS bias. Bootstrap intervals retain the fixed saved ensembles.

training.interpretation: Within-method training behavior only; denoising losses across target grids are not comparable forecast scores. Endpoint summaries do not establish convergence.
